title: Season 1
overview: Clint Barton and Kate Bishop battle the Tracksuit Mafia and unravel a holiday conspiracy.

episodes.overview: Clint and Kate escape Maya Lopez and the Tracksuit Mafia in a car chase across New York.

episodes.overview: Secrets are revealed about Clint’s family and an unexpected assassin enters the fray.
